prompt: Single game hero sprite: A young, agile, confident male blade-fighter, the Azure Dragon Saber, drawn with sturdy heroic proportions about 4.3 heads tall: a head about 24% of the whole figure height (clearly smaller than a cartoon head, but not a small head, never chibi), an ATHLETIC balanced build with defined but not bulky muscles, broad shoulders narrowing to a lean waist, strong forearms, strong hands a little bigger than life, lean legs that make about 45% of the figure height, a quick runner in light boots, a light springy stance, never cute, never a mascot. His face is young, sharp and handsome, small on the head and built from the fewest bold shapes: thin angular dark brows, TWO narrow GLOWING pale-gold eye shapes with no pupils as the brightest points of the face, a small nose shape, a sharp defined jaw and cheekbone line with no beard, one small confident smirk line, the skin in two flat tones; black hair swept back into a sleek high ponytail drawn as a few solid clumps of modest volume, tied with a crimson cord, and a cream headband whose two long tails stream back. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: a very long scarf in light cobalt blue with a cream lining, wrapped around his neck and streaming behind him as ONE big flowing shape down to his knees; his arm on the RIGHT side of the image is bare from the shoulder with a cream bracer, and his arm on the LEFT side of the image wears a deep-blue sleeve with ONE big overlapping scale-shaped shoulder plate with a cream edge. He wears a fitted deep-blue jacket with a high collar and a cream edge band, a wide cream sash belt with two hanging crimson sash tails, loose deep-blue trousers gathered at the ankle, and light brown boots with wrap straps on EACH leg (identical). In the hand on the LEFT side of the image he holds ONE great dao, a long-hafted broad curved blade: a very long straight dark-wood haft taller than he is with a crimson tassel just below the blade, and at the top ONE huge broad curved single-edged blade of bright silver steel with a large pale highlight shape and a darker blue-grey back ridge, as big as his torso, its edge curving forward, with a flat cobalt-and-cream dragon-head shape biting the root of the blade as the guard; held by a clearly visible gripping fist at about the height of his hip; the hand on the RIGHT side of the image is an empty relaxed fist the same size as the dao hand. COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: ONE dominant hue, a deep cobalt blue (hue about 228 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #162052, base #2E45A0, light #6482D6, top highlight #B5C8F5. ONE warm family for the skin, the boots and the haft: tan skin #D69A63 with shadow #9A5F3C and light #F0C08A, boots #A8764A and haft woods #7A4E31 and #4B2F20. Cream #EFE2BE with warm-grey shadow #BFAE8A for the scarf lining, the headband, the sash and the edge bands; steel #C9D3E0 with shadow #8A97AB and light #EAF1F8 ONLY for the blade. ONE small accent family, crimson #D8353A with shadow #8F1F25, ONLY on the hair cord, the tassel and the sash tails; the glowing eyes in pale warm gold #FFE9A6. Rules: large areas are mid values and the deep blue is clearly lighter than navy, never near-black; only the eyes and the small crimson accents are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline is a dark mauve-brown #241B2B. NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT of the image, the face looking slightly right, the whole chest visible. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and the same size, neither hidden; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT, tall and poised, in a relaxed ready stance with a living pose: the body upright, the head tilted about 8 degrees toward the right of the image, his left shoulder about 5% of the figure height lower than the right, the weight on his left leg with the right knee a little bent and the right foot resting on its toe, both feet on the ground line; the dao stands beside his left hand with the butt of the haft on the ground line, the haft tilted about 8 degrees so that the blade leans toward the upper-left of the image, the whole dao clear of the legs and fully inside the frame with the top of the blade at least 8% below the top edge. Full body, centered, filling about 66% of the frame height. At most four colour families. Everything stays inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a bold heroic cartoon hero illustration with flat shapes, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Bold chunky flat shapes with sharp angular accents and a confident heroic silhouette, proportions stylized: broad shoulders, lean waist, sturdy legs, the scarf and the blade enlarged; never chibi. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), with the large areas kept in MID values so the figure stays readable when shrunk; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. VERY thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), about three times thicker on the outer silhouette than on inner lines, with rounded joins, as bold as a game sprite outline. Bold flat shapes only, the skin in two flat hard-edged tones with NO soft shading, NO airbrush highlights. A few small flat speckle spots of a lighter or darker tone are scattered on the jacket and the skin. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one scale plate, a scarf, a dragon head, a tassel), no fine engraving, no filigree, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
